title: German Eggplant Tagine
description: A traditional German twist on the North African dish, featuring grilled eggplant and a rich mediterranean-inspired sauce.
instructions: Brush the eggplant slices with zesty olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the eggplant slices for 3-4 minutes per side, until tender and lightly charred.
In a large saucepan, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the mediterranean tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the tagine spice.
Add the grilled eggplant slices to the saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes, until coated in the sauce.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese.
